title: TensorPlate Scheduler Config
description:
Runtime configuration consumed by the serving worker to construct an InferScheduler. Mirrors include/tensorplate/scheduler/scheduler.hpp::SchedulerConfig.

v0.1.0 supports the 'fifo' policy. Unknown policy strings are rejected with Error::Code::Unsupported. All durations are monotonic; wall-clock time is never consulted.

policy.description: Stable scheduler policy key. v0.1.0 supports only 'fifo'.

queue_capacity.description: Maximum admitted-but-undispatched depth. Admission past this returns Error::Code::OOMError.

in_flight_capacity.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight requests. Defaults to 1 to reflect the single-session serving model.

deadline_margin_ms.description: Deadline-margin in milliseconds. The scheduler accepts a request whose estimated completion is at most this many milliseconds later than its deadline.

default_service_estimate_ms.description: Service-time estimate in milliseconds when no per-request estimate is available.

pressure_reject_threshold.description: Pressure severity at which new admission is rejected. 'normal' disables pressure-based rejection (record-only mode); 'critical' is the recommended v0.1.0 default.
